response.sql: WITH event_ratio AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratio) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / a.avg_spend_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratio e CROSS JOIN avg_ratio a ORDER BY (e.spend_ratio / a.avg_spend_ratio IS NULL), e.spend_ratio / a.avg_spend_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
